title: [FEATURE] Expose Claude.ai plan usage in statusLine JSON payload
body:
## Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

## Problem Statement

When using Claude Code with a Claude Pro/Max subscription, there's no way to monitor plan usage limits without manually visiting https://claude.ai/settings/usage in a browser. This leads to unexpected rate limiting mid-session.

I use a custom `statusLine` hook to display context window usage, but I cannot display plan usage because that data isn't available in the JSON payload passed to the hook.

Attempts to scrape the data from claude.ai are blocked by Cloudflare (headless browsers, curl, even visible automated browsers get stuck in verification loops).

## Proposed Solution

Add `plan_usage` to the JSON payload passed to custom `statusLine` commands:

```json
{
  "context_window": { "used": 72, "total": 100 },
  "plan_usage": { "used_percent": 64, "resets_in": "2h15m" }
}
```

This would allow custom status lines to display:

```
Opus 4.5 │ my-project ███████░░░ 72% │ ██████░░░░ 64% ⏱ 2h15m
          ↑ model      ↑ context window  ↑ plan usage  ↑ resets in
```

## Alternative Solutions

- **Scraping claude.ai** - Blocked by Cloudflare bot protection
- **Using API rate limit headers** - Only shows rate limits, not subscription quota
- **Manually checking the website** - Breaks workflow, defeats the purpose

## Priority

**High - Significant impact on productivity**

Unexpected rate limiting mid-session disrupts work and wastes context.

## Feature Category

**Configuration and settings** (statusLine hook payload)

## Use Case Example

1. I start a Claude Code session for a complex refactoring task
2. My custom statusLine shows context window at 45%
3. I'd also see plan usage at 78% with "1h 30m" until reset
4. I know I should wrap up soon or wait for reset before starting another big task
5. This prevents surprise rate limiting mid-task

## Additional Context

**Scope:** This applies only to subscription-based accounts (Claude Pro/Max). API accounts (pay-as-you-go) have no usage cap to display.

**Current statusLine config example:**
```json
{
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "node \"/path/to/custom-statusline.js\""
  }
}
```

The hook already receives `context_window` data - this request is to add `plan_usage` alongside it.

top_comments.author: palonsorodriguez
top_comments.body:
**Important context:** Claude Code already has access to this usage data internally. When usage reaches 90%, it displays:

> You've used 90% of your session limit · resets 11pm (UTC) · /upgrade to keep using Claude Code

This means the data is already available within Claude Code - the request is simply to expose it in the `statusLine` JSON payload so custom hooks can display it proactively (before hitting 90%).

top_comments.author: JDFagan
top_comments.body:
+1 on this. I have a custom statusline script and hit the exact same wall — context_window and cost data are available but subscription quota data is not.

Additional suggestion: The /status > Usage tab labels the daily quota as "Current session", which is confusing in the Claude Code context. "Session" already means the current CLI conversation (whose context window is a separate metric). Having both concepts use the word "session" across different parts of the UI creates unnecessary ambiguity.
